    (hC_proximityGapAffineLines : e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat
      (F := F) (A := A) (ι := ι) (C := MC) (e := e) (ε := ε))
    (h_interleaved_gaps : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≥ 1 →
      e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat (F := F)
        (A := InterleavedSymbol A (Fin m)) (ι := ι) (C := MC ^⋈ (Fin m)) e ε) :
    ∀ (ϑ : ℕ), (hϑ_gt_0 : ϑ > 0) → δ_ε_multilinearCorrelatedAgreement_Nat (F := F) (A := A)
      (ι := ι) (C := MC) (ϑ := ϑ) (e := e) (ε := ε) := by
  classical
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => exact fun h => (Nat.not_lt_zero _ h).elim
  | succ n ih =>
    cases n with
    | zero =>
      simp only [Nat.zero_add, Nat.zero_lt_one, forall_const]
      intro u hp
      simp only [multilinearCombine₁_eq_affineLineEvaluation,
        prob_uniform_singleton_finFun_eq (P := fun r =>
          Δ₀(affineLineEvaluation (u 0) (u 1) r, MC) ≤ e),

      have h := hC_proximityGapAffineLines (u 0) (u 1) hp

        funext i
        match i with
        | 0 => rfl
        | 1 => rfl
      simpa only [jointProximityNat₂, hu] using h
    | succ n =>
      intro _ u hp
      simp only [multilinearCombine_recursive_form (u := u)] at hp
      simp only [Fin.init_def] at hp
      have ht := prob_R_star_gt_threshold (MC := MC) (ε := ε) u e (by
        rw [← prob_split_last_uniform_sampling_of_finFun]
        simpa only [multilinearCombine_affineComb_split_last_close,
          Fin.init, ENNReal.coe_mul, ENNReal.coe_natCast] using hp)
      apply CA_split_rowwise_implies_CA (C := MC) u e
      apply h_interleaved_gaps (2 ^ (n + 1)) Nat.one_le_two_pow
      apply lt_of_lt_of_le ht
      apply Pr_le_Pr_of_implies
      intro r hr
      exact correlatedAgreement_of_mem_R_star_tensor MC (ih (Nat.succ_pos n)) u ⟨r, hr⟩
